parts.target: An **ADEPTA SORORITAS** unit of yours that has not yet been **selected to fight** in the phase.
parts.effect: Whenever a [pile-in move](vsdata:core-rule/pile-in-move) or [consolidation move](vsdata:core-rule/consolidation-move) is made by a model in the unit, it can cover up to 6" rather than 3", for the rest of the turn. data.summary:
**When:** [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase).

**Target:** An **ADEPTA SORORITAS** unit of yours that has not yet been **selected to fight** in the phase.

**Effect:** Whenever a [pile-in move](vsdata:core-rule/pile-in-move) or [consolidation move](vsdata:core-rule/consolidation-move) is made by a model in the unit, it can cover up to 6" rather than 3", for the rest of the turn. If the unit is [Righteous](vsdata:ability/adepta-sororitas.champions-of-faith.righteous-purpose), the model need not end the move nearer the nearest enemy model, if it ends it as near as possible to the nearest enemy unit.

righteousException.waives: finish closer to the closest enemy model
righteousException.requires: finish as close as possible to the closest enemy unit
